item.title: Scammers suing Ocala businesses over bogus slip-and-fall claims should be punished
item.description: "We are not the car wash city anymore, we've become the slip & fall/sue you city. Publix has been a main target, but there's been others too, all pretty recently. If you watch local network television, it's mostly lawyer ads. These "accidents" must be on security tape and should be examined carefully to show who is the real victim. Scammers should be punished! Cars are not the only thing in Ocala that need cleaning up." - A Marion County resident shares her opinion. Read more: Scammers suing Oca

item.description: A 16-year-old boy from Levy County suffered fatal injuries on Friday after he lost control of his all-terrain vehicle and was ejected from the vehicle. Read more: Teen killed in ATV accident near Marion County

item.title: I-75 backed up for miles after semi truck blocks lanes
item.description: Travelers on Interstate 75 are experiencing heavy traffic for large stretches of Interstate 75 in Marion County on Saturday, with northbound lanes mostly blocked for the last several hours due to an accident involving a semi-truck. item.title: Community banding together for Ocala family who lost father to cardiac event
item.description: The community has rallied to support the family of an Ocala husband and father who died unexpectedly just over a week before Christmas, contributing nearly $50,000 to a GoFundMe established to benefit the late man's wife and children. Read more: Community banding together for Ocala family who lost father to cardiac event

item.title: We live in the middle of nowhere in Marion County and rarely use public goods. Why are our property taxes going up?
item.description: "I read the piece about property taxes, we live in the south forest area, about one hour from Ocala. We have 3.4 acres in the middle of nowhere. We take trash eight miles each direction and my only child is 30, yet property taxes went up $1,000 this year and will go up another $1,000 in 2026. Same thing paying for a bunch of stuff we don't get or need. We called 911 a few years ago and we were told if it's an emergency and you need police, you should handle it yourself.
